taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.content:
Professional Tax Solutions for Individuals and Businesses

We understand that navigating Canada's tax system can be challenging. Our tax professionals provide accurate, efficient, and compliant tax services to help you maximize your deductions, minimize your tax liability, and meet all Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) requirements.

Whether you're filing a simple personal tax return or managing complex tax obligations, we're committed to delivering reliable guidance tailored to your financial situation.

Personal Income Tax

Our team prepares accurate and timely personal income tax returns while helping you maximize available deductions and credits.

Our services include:

  • T1 Personal Income Tax Returns
  • Tax planning and optimization
  • Investment income reporting
  • Rental property income
  • Capital gains reporting
  • Foreign income reporting
  • Self-employed tax returns
  • Pension income splitting
  • RRSP, FHSA and TFSA tax planning
  • Family tax planning

Corporate Tax Services

We help businesses meet their tax obligations while developing strategies to improve tax efficiency.

Services include:

  • T2 Corporate Income Tax Returns
  • Corporate tax planning
  • Small business tax planning
  • Shareholder tax strategies
  • Dividend planning
  • Year-end tax preparation
  • Corporate reorganizations
  • Business succession tax planning

Quebec Tax Services

For individuals and businesses operating in Quebec, we provide specialized tax services that address both federal and provincial filing requirements.

Our Quebec tax services include:

  • Quebec Personal Income Tax Returns (TP-1)
  • Quebec Corporate Tax Returns (CO-17)
  • Revenu Québec compliance
  • Quebec tax credits and incentives
  • Tax planning for Quebec residents
  • Interprovincial tax considerations
  • Assistance with Revenu Québec audits and notices

Our professionals understand the unique requirements of Quebec's tax system and help clients navigate both federal and provincial obligations accordingly.

Estate, Trust & Succession Tax Services

Planning your estate is one of the most important steps in protecting your family's financial future. We provide tax guidance for estates, trusts, beneficiaries, executors, and families during estate administration.

Our estate tax services include:

  • Estate tax planning
  • Final (terminal) tax returns
  • Estate (T3) Trust Income Tax Returns
  • Trust tax compliance
  • Executor tax assistance
  • Capital gains planning at death
  • Tax-efficient wealth transfer strategies
  • Charitable giving strategies
  • Family succession planning
  • Business succession tax planning

Our advisors work closely with legal professionals and financial planners to help ensure your estate is administered correctly while minimizing tax liabilities where possible.

CRA & Revenu Québec Representation

Our staff recognizes that receiving a letter from the Canada Revenue Agency or Revenu Québec can be quite stressful. Our professionals can communicate with tax authorities on your behalf and assist with resolving tax matters.

  • CRA audit support
  • Revenu Québec audit assistance
  • Payment arrangement guidance
  • Tax account reviews
  • Notice of Assessment reviews
  • Voluntary disclosures
  • Tax adjustments and amendments

advisory.title: Advisory
advisory.content:
New to Canada, Leaving Canada & Non-Resident Services

Whether you are establishing yourself in Canada, growing a business, purchasing an investment property, or preparing to leave Canada, Capital Pro Inc. provides coordinated advisory and consulting services to help you make informed decisions.

We work with individuals, families, entrepreneurs, corporations, newcomers, emigrants, and non-residents. Our practical approach brings together tax planning, accounting, business consulting, and property management support—all tailored to your circumstances.

Helping You Establish Your Financial Life in Canada and Beyond

Moving to Canada is a major transition. Canada’s tax system, banking practices, government benefits, and business requirements may be unfamiliar. We help newcomers understand their obligations, organize their finances, and begin their Canadian journey with greater confidence.

Our newcomer services may include:

  • Canadian tax-residency consultation
  • First-year Canadian income-tax returns
  • Foreign income and asset-reporting guidance
  • GST/HST credit and benefit information
  • Canada Child Benefit guidance
  • Tax identification and CRA account support
  • Rental-property tax guidance
  • Coordination with immigration lawyers and other licensed professionals

Whether you are arriving as an individual, with your family, or as an entrepreneur, we provide clear explanations and practical support suited to your situation.

Leaving Canada

Planning Your Departure with Confidence

Leaving Canada can create important tax, business, property, and reporting obligations. Planning before your departure can help reduce complications and prevent unexpected tax consequences.

Our departure and emigration services may include:

  • Canadian tax-residency assessment
  • Departure tax planning
  • Identification of assets affected by deemed-disposition rules
  • Final resident income-tax return preparation
  • Foreign-property reporting review
  • Registered-account considerations
  • Canadian rental-property planning
  • CRA notification and account support
  • Coordination with professionals in your destination country

We recommend beginning the planning process before you leave Canada whenever possible.

Non-Resident Tax Services

Canadian Support Wherever You Live

If you live outside Canada but earn Canadian income, own Canadian property, or maintain Canadian business interests, you may continue to have Canadian tax and reporting obligations.

We assist non-residents with:

  • Canadian non-resident tax returns
  • Canadian rental-income reporting
  • Non-resident withholding-tax compliance
  • NR4 reporting support
  • NR6 applications for rental-property owners
  • Section 216 tax returns
  • Sale of Canadian real estate and Section 116 support
  • Clearance-certificate coordination
  • Canadian corporate and business filings
  • CRA correspondence and account assistance
  • Coordination with Canadian lawyers, real-estate professionals, and overseas tax advisors

Our objective is to help you remain organized and compliant while managing your Canadian affairs from abroad.

Property Management for Non-Residents

Protecting and Managing Your Canadian Property from Abroad

Managing a Canadian property while living in another country can be challenging. Capital Pro Inc. provides property management and financial administration support designed for non-resident owners.

Depending on the property and service agreement, our support may include:

  • Tenant communication and administrative support
  • Rent collection and payment monitoring
  • Coordination of repairs and maintenance
  • Property inspections
  • Expense tracking and recordkeeping
  • Payment of approved property expenses
  • Monthly or periodic owner statements
  • Rental-income bookkeeping
  • Non-resident tax-withholding administration
  • NR4 information-return support
  • NR6 and Section 216 tax-return coordination
  • Assistance when purchasing or selling a Canadian property
  • Coordination with licensed real-estate professionals, lawyers, contractors, and insurers

Our integrated approach helps property owners manage both the operational and tax-related aspects of their Canadian investments.

Important Notice

Capital Pro Inc. provides tax, accounting, administrative, and business consulting services. Information provided through this website is general in nature and should not be considered legal, immigration, or investment advice. Where regulated professional services are required, clients should consult with an appropriately licensed professional. Services are subject to an engagement agreement and an assessment of each client’s circumstances.
